  /* Hide the default Quarto title block on the homepage; we render our own hero. */
  #title-block-header { display: none !important; }

  .sm-card{
    position: relative;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  }

  .sm-card::before{
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 1.1rem;

    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;

  .sm-card:hover{
    transform: translateY(-6px);

<script>
(function(){
  // ---- Starfield / constellation canvas background ----
  var canvas = document.getElementById('sm-canvas');
  if (canvas && canvas.getContext) {
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var wrap = canvas.parentElement;
    var W, H, dpr;
    var particles = [];
    var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var count = Math.min(70, Math.floor((window.innerWidth || 1200) / 18));

    function resize(){
      dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      W = wrap.clientWidth;
      H = wrap.clientHeight;
      canvas.width = W * dpr;
      canvas.height = H * dpr;
      canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }

    function init(){
      particles = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
          x: Math.random() * W,
          y: Math.random() * H,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25,
          r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.6
        });
      }
    }

    function step(){
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      var maxDist = 130;
      for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        var p = particles[i];
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
        if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.vx *= -1;
        if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.vy *= -1;

        for (var j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          var q = particles[j];
          var dx = p.x - q.x, dy = p.y - q.y;
          var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (dist < maxDist) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,' + (0.16 * (1 - dist / maxDist)) + ')';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
            ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
      for (var k = 0; k < particles.length; k++) {
        var pt = particles[k];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,225,255,0.85)';
        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      if (!reduceMotion) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    resize();
    init();
    step();
    window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ resize(); init(); });
  }

  // ---- Typewriter subtitle ----
  var typedEl = document.getElementById('sm-typed-text');
  if (typedEl) {
    var phrases = [
      'Interactive lectures, tools, and games for learning statistics and data science.',
      'From probability basics to regression, all free and open.',
      'Build charts, run simulations, and master core concepts.'
    ];
    var pi = 0, ci = 0, deleting = false;

    function tick(){
      var current = phrases[pi];
      if (!deleting) {
        ci++;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === current.length) {
          deleting = true;
          setTimeout(tick, 1800);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        ci--;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === 0) {
          deleting = false;
          pi = (pi + 1) % phrases.length;
        }
      }
      setTimeout(tick, deleting ? 25 : 35);
    }
    tick();
  }

  // ---- Stat counters (animate when visible) ----
  var nums = document.querySelectorAll('.sm-num[data-count]');
  function animateCount(el){
    var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10) || 0;
    var start = 0;
    var duration = 1200;
    var startTime = null;
    function frame(ts){
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      el.textContent = Math.floor(progress * (target - start) + start);
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else el.textContent = target;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    nums.forEach(function(n){ io.observe(n); });
  } else {
    nums.forEach(animateCount);
  }
})();
</script>
